{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|I just turned seventeen. That's the age of responsibility on Alderaan.''"<br />"''Same as Corellia. Too young. When I was seventeen, I didn't have a bit of sense.|[[Winter Celchu|Winter]] and Bria Tharen|<ref name="RD">''[[Rebel Dawn]]''</ref>}}
The '''age of responsibility''' was the age at which a [[Sentience|sentient]] was capable of being legally responsible for all of their acts, and was entitled to the management of their own affairs.

On [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] and [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], two member [[Planet/Legends|planets]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], the age of responsibility was set at seventeen. [[Bria Tharen]], a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] who became a [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] at the age of twenty-six, once commented that she was not sufficiently mature when she came of age.<ref name="RD" />

In [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] society, children of both sexes would face the rite of passage known as the ''[[verd'goten]]'' at the age of thirteen. Those who passed the trials were subsequently declared adults.<ref name="TMPaC">''{{InsiderCite|86|The Mandalorians: People and Culture}}''</ref>

On [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], youths became full adults independent of their parents at age twenty-one.<ref name="Plagueis">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref> Despite that, the right to vote and to be elected was granted on merit and intellectual development, regardless of the biological age, which led to individuals as young as thirteen occupying the [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|throne]] of Naboo&mdash;and even younger monarchs were known to have been chosen.<ref name="SON">''[[Secrets of Naboo]]''</ref>

In some cultures, it was possible for a youth to be freed from the influence of a parent or guardian before he or she came of age. The [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]], however, did not honor that practice.<ref name="Plagueis" />

In [[alien]] races with lifespans differing from [[human]]s, the age of responsibility could be much different. In [[Hutt]]s, who could live over 1000 [[Standard year|years]]<ref name="Star Wars: Women of the Galaxy">''[[Star Wars: Women of the Galaxy]]''</ref>, the age of responsibility was not until they had fully grown at 200 years old <ref name="Databank original">Hutt in the [[Databank (original)|Databank]] {{C|content now obsolete; [https://web.archive.org/web/20110524181439/http://starwars.com/databank/species/hutt/index.html backup link]}}</ref> . This made [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]'s rise to power at the incredibly young age of 80 even more remarkable.
